  sb_create_signed_url
  - **Auth Admin (5):** sb_list_users,
  sb_get_user, sb_create_user, sb_update_user,
  sb_delete_user
  - **Projects (5):** sb_list_projects,

detail.description:
MCP server for Supabase — 31 tools for database
   CRUD, storage, auth admin, project management,
   edge functions, and secrets via REST +
  Management APIs.

  ## Features

  - Database CRUD with PostgREST filtering,
  resource embedding (JOINs), and RPC
  - Storage bucket and object management with
  signed URLs
  - Auth admin for user creation, updates, bans,
  and deletion
  - Project lifecycle management (create, pause,
  restore)
  - Execute SQL queries and generate TypeScript
  types
  - Edge function inspection and secret/API key
  management

  ## 31 Tools

  - **Database REST (6):** sb_list_records,
  sb_insert_records, sb_update_records,
  sb_upsert_records, sb_delete_records,
  sb_call_function
  - **Storage (6):** sb_list_buckets,
  sb_create_bucket, sb_delete_bucket,
  sb_list_objects, sb_delete_objects,
  sb_create_signed_url
  - **Auth Admin (5):** sb_list_users,
  sb_get_user, sb_create_user, sb_update_user,
  sb_delete_user
  - **Projects (5):** sb_list_projects,
  sb_get_project, sb_create_project,
  sb_pause_project, sb_restore_project
  - **Database Management (3):** sb_run_query,
  sb_list_migrations, sb_get_typescript_types
  - **Edge Functions (2):** sb_list_functions,
  sb_get_function
  - **Secrets & Keys (4):** sb_list_secrets,
  sb_create_secrets, sb_delete_secrets,
  sb_list_api_keys

  ## Configuration

  - `SUPABASE_URL` — Project URL (e.g.
  `https://xxx.supabase.co`) — for database,
  storage, auth tools
  - `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` — Service role
  key (bypasses RLS) — from Settings → API
  - `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` — Personal access
  token — for project management tools (from
  dashboard → Account → Access Tokens)

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Service role key from Settings → API

tools.name: sb_list_records
tools.description: List records from a Supabase table/view with PostgREST filtering, column selection, ordering, and pagination. Filter syntax: age=gt.18, status=eq.active, name=ilike.*john*, id=in.(1,2,3). Resource embedding (JOINs): select=*,orders(*)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

order.description: Sort order. Example: created_at.desc or name.asc.nullslast

offset.description: Number of records to skip (for pagination)

select.description: Columns to return. Supports embedding: *,orders(*) or id,user:user_id(name,email)

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (Smithery quality param)

tools.name: sb_insert_records
tools.description: Insert one or more records into a Supabase table. Pass a single object or an array of objects. Use return=representation to get the created records back.

return.description: Return preference. representation=full record, minimal=no body, headers-only=headers

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

records.description: Single record object or array of record objects to insert

tools.name: sb_update_records
tools.description: Update records in a Supabase table matching a filter. Filter is REQUIRED to prevent accidental full-table updates. Use return=representation to see what changed.

data.description: Fields to update as key-value pairs

filter.description: PostgREST filter (REQUIRED). Example: id=eq.123 or status=eq.draft

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_upsert_records
tools.description: Upsert (insert or update on conflict) records in a Supabase table. Uses merge-duplicates by default. Specify on_conflict for non-primary-key columns.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

records.description: Single record object or array of record objects to upsert

on_conflict.description: Column(s) to detect conflicts on, if not primary key. Example: email

tools.name: sb_delete_records
tools.description: Delete records from a Supabase table matching a filter. Filter is REQUIRED to prevent accidental full-table deletion. Use sb_list_records first to verify which records will be deleted.

filter.description: PostgREST filter (REQUIRED). Example: id=eq.123 or status=eq.archived

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_call_function
tools.description: Call a stored PostgreSQL function (RPC) in Supabase. Use method=GET for immutable functions, POST for volatile ones (default).

method.description: HTTP method. GET for immutable, POST for volatile (default: POST)

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_buckets
tools.description: List all storage buckets in the Supabase project. Returns bucket name, public status, size limits, and allowed MIME types.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_create_bucket
tools.description: Create a new storage bucket in Supabase. Set public=true for publicly accessible files. Optionally set file size limit and allowed MIME types.

public.description: Whether files are publicly accessible (default: false)

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

file_size_limit.description: Maximum file size in bytes (e.g. 1048576 for 1MB)

tools.name: sb_delete_bucket
tools.description: Delete a storage bucket from Supabase. The bucket must be empty before deletion. Use sb_delete_objects to remove files first.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_objects
tools.description: List objects (files) in a Supabase storage bucket. Supports prefix filtering, pagination, and search.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default: 100)

prefix.description: Filter by path prefix (folder). Example: images/ or uploads/2026/

search.description: Search term to filter objects by name

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

sort_column.description: Column to sort by: name, created_at, updated_at

tools.name: sb_delete_objects
tools.description: Delete one or more objects from a Supabase storage bucket. Provide an array of file paths to delete.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

prefixes.description: Array of file paths to delete. Example: ["images/photo.jpg", "uploads/doc.pdf"]

tools.name: sb_create_signed_url
tools.description: Create a temporary signed URL for a private storage object. The URL expires after the specified duration.

path.description: Object file path within the bucket

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

expires_in.description: URL expiration time in seconds (e.g. 3600 for 1 hour)

tools.name: sb_list_users
tools.description: List all users in the Supabase Auth system. Returns paginated results with user details including email, metadata, and creation date.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_get_user
tools.description: Get a single user by ID from Supabase Auth. Returns full user details including metadata, identities, and last sign-in.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_create_user
tools.description: Create a new user in Supabase Auth. Set email_confirm=true to skip email verification. Use app_metadata for admin-controlled data (roles, permissions).

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_update_user
tools.description: Update a user in Supabase Auth. Can change email, phone, password, metadata, or ban the user.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_delete_user
tools.description: Delete a user from Supabase Auth. This permanently removes the user and all their auth data.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_projects
tools.description: List all Supabase projects in your account. Returns project name, ref, region, status, and database info. Requires SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_get_project
tools.description: Get details of a specific Supabase project by reference ID. Returns name, region, status, database host, and API URL.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_create_project
tools.description: Create a new Supabase project. Requires organization ID, region, and database password. Project creation takes a few minutes.

region.description: AWS region. Examples: us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_pause_project
tools.description: Pause a Supabase project. Paused projects stop all services (database, auth, storage) and free up resources. Free tier projects auto-pause after inactivity.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_restore_project
tools.description: Restore a paused Supabase project. Restarts all services including database, auth, and storage.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_run_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query on a Supabase project database via the Management API. Supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE TABLE, and all SQL. Returns query results as JSON.

query.description: SQL query to execute. Example: SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_migrations
tools.description: List database migrations for a Supabase project. Shows migration version, name, and status.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_get_typescript_types
tools.description: Generate TypeScript type definitions from the Supabase project database schema. Useful for type-safe database access.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_functions
tools.description: List all Edge Functions deployed to a Supabase project. Returns function slug, name, status, and creation date.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_get_function
tools.description: Get details of a specific Edge Function by slug. Returns function metadata, status, version, and entry point.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_secrets
tools.description: List all secrets (environment variables) for a Supabase project. Returns secret names only (values are never exposed).

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_create_secrets
tools.description: Create or update secrets (environment variables) for a Supabase project. If a secret with the same name exists, it will be overwritten.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_delete_secrets
tools.description: Delete secrets (environment variables) from a Supabase project by name.

names.description: Array of secret names to delete. Example: ["API_KEY", "WEBHOOK_URL"]

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

tools.name: sb_list_api_keys
tools.description: List API keys for a Supabase project. Returns anon key, service_role key, and any custom keys with their names and roles.

_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response
